title: net2 gate, round 7vq: the veto with q's threshold at 0
description: Round 7's gate3 students (exp-net2-r7-gate3-124) exported with q, their belief in copies, vetoing the push (PPOSpec gate3_copies "rule": u = u_rule + p' (1 - q') (share - u_rule)) met every gate condition but copies at teacher gain 1 (exp-net2-gate-r7v-128): +0.147 (+0.069 to +0.227) with Cubic from the start, +0.059 (+0.017 to +0.099) in the competition conditions, five-family mean +0.037, copies -0.145 (-0.211 to -0.077). Both thresholds were 0.5 there, so among copies, where q was 0.55 to 0.72 in training, the veto q' was only 0.1 to 0.44, while q elsewhere was 0.21 to 0.26. Here the same six students are exported with the threshold on q at 0 (p's stays 0.5) for a stronger veto: the thresholds 0.3 and 0 were fixed before either gate ran, and each gets its own gate because the rule keeps the best five-family mean, which leaves copies out. Policies in release model-net2-r7vq0-cands. They run next to the fixed rule on net1 v5 (u = 0.25, release model-net1v5) and BBRv3 on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies for 30 s, with campaign seed 21. The share rule at k = 0.5 and 1 on net1 v5 also runs, as a reference and not a candidate: it is what the teacher does wherever a stock TCP flow is active, so with the fixed rule it bounds what the student can reach. The rule is unchanged (experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py): per link, the mean over a candidate's seeds of its log utility minus the rule's; the candidate kept has the highest five-family mean; the gate passes if it beats the rule in cubic-first-60 and in new-20's competition conditions, each with its 95% interval over links above 0, is at or above the rule on the five-family mean, and is not worse with copies beyond its interval. A candidate that passes runs once on the test links. Validation links only.
prepare: (cd "$IN/c" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); (cd "$IN/m" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$IN/m/net1v5.pt" --u0 0.25 --k 0.5 1; P=(--policy "rule-v5=$IN/m/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "share-k0.5=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k0.5.onnx" --policy "share-k1=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k1.onnx"); for f in "$IN"/c/ppo-*.onnx; do P+=(--policy "$(basename "$f" .onnx)=$f"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && mv "$OUT/summary.md" "$OUT/against-bbr3.md" && uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py "$OUT"
